name: Tamil
notes: Tamil has no upper case: never use a caps style, use weight 700-800 instead.
Tamil is agglutinative, so single words are long. Break lines at word boundaries, never mid-word, and budget 1.32x the English character count.
Ascenders and descenders sit on both sides of the line: line_height below 1.08 clips them.
Never stretch Tamil glyphs horizontally to fill a frame - the letterforms distort and readers notice immediately.
whisper small.* hallucinates on Tamil. large-v3 only.
On-screen digits stay in Latin numerals; that is what the audience reads.
Starting defaults, not measurements. Measure three videos in your niche before quoting these numbers.
